# Liftoo

> Personal shopping assistant app in Patna, Bihar, India

Liftoo is an on-demand platform that connects shoppers in Patna with KYC-verified assistants for malls, markets and family outings. Book via the Android app; pay only after service.

## Location

- City: Patna
- State: Bihar
- Country: India
- Service area: Patna and nearby areas in Bihar
- Coordinates: 25.5941, 85.1376

## Services

1. Bag carry assistance — assistant carries shopping bags while you browse
2. Queue assistance — assistant waits in billing or service queues
3. Family shopping help — support for family outings and group shopping
4. Senior citizen help — trusted assistance for parents and seniors, trackable in-app
5. Festival shopping — help during exhibitions, festivals and busy market days

## How booking works

1. Download Liftoo from Google Play (Android)
2. Sign up and choose a location in Patna (mall or market)
3. Pick a service and duration (30 min to 4 hours)
4. Track assistant live on map with in-app chat and OTP start
5. Pay after job completion via wallet, UPI or cash

## Key facts

- Assistants are KYC-verified before taking jobs
- Transparent hourly rates shown in app before booking
- No upfront booking fee
- Based in Patna, Bihar, India
- Product of GOLAX (https://www.golaxindia.com)
- Legal entity: DLEAFTECH PRIVATE LIMITED

## Popular venues in Patna

P&M Mall, City Centre Mall, Unity One Mall, Maurya Lok, Patna One, Boring Road Market, Fraser Road, Khaitan Market, Patliputra Colony, Kankarbagh Market, Bailey Road, Hartali More
